own_solution.law: Reversible engine with finite hot body: total entropy change zero, W = m c [(T1 - T0) - T0 ln(T1/T0)]
assumptions: tank insulated so heat leaves only via the engine
'same temperature' for the first tank means 360 K

notes: ln(360/290) = 0.216223; T0 ln = 62.705 K; 70 - 62.705 = 7.2954 K. m c = 8372 J/K gives W = 61077 J (about 61.1 kJ). With 3.4 kg: 14232.4 J/K * 7.2954 = 103831 J. Second-tank sentences: the second tank is not connected to the engine, so D; 'the same temperature' for the second tank is somewhat vague (the second tank's water temperature is not given) but cannot affect the answer. The 'small amount' sentences carry no number; treated as non-numeric controls.
